#!/usr/bin/env python3 
"""Synchronize agent rules and skills from the .agents/ to Cursor, Claude, and Copilot."""

import re 
from pathlib import Path

PLATFORMS = ("cursor", "claude", "github") 
PLATFORM_LABELS = { 
"cursor": "Cursor (AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/, .cursor/skills/)", 
"claude": "Claude (CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md, .claude/rules/, .claude/skills/)", 
"github": "GitHub Copilot (AGENTS.md, .github/instructions/, .github/skills/)", 
}

CLAUDE_ENTRY = """@AGENTS.md"""

IGNORE_HEADER = ( 
"# Generated by scripts/sync_agents.py — do not edit. Source of truth: .agents/\n" 
)

Each tool reads only its synced runtime config; ignore source + other platforms.
IGNORE_FILES: dict[str, list[str]] = { 
".cursorignore": [ 
".agents/", 
"",

".claude/",

def repo_root() -> Path: 
return Path(file).resolve().parent.parent


def source_root() -> Path: 
return repo_root() / ".agents"


def platform_root(platform: str, root: Path) -> Path: 
if platform  "github": 
return root / ".github" 
return root / f".{platform}"


def dest_rule_path(platform: str, name: str, root: Path) -> Path: 
base = platform_root(platform, root) 
if platform  "github": 
return base / "instructions" / f"{name}.instructions.md" 
if platform  "claude": 
return b/--- [scripts PARTE 2/7] --- 
ase / "rules" / f"{name}.md" 
return base / "rules" / f"{name}.mdc"


_FRONTMATTER_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z]*:")


def _is_frontmatter_key(line: str) -> bool: 
return bool(_FRONTMATTER_KEY_RE.match(line))


def _read_block_scalar(lines: list[str], index: int) -> tuple[str, int]: 
"""Read YAML folded (>) or literal (|) scalar continuation lines.""" 
block_lines: list[str] = [] 
while index < len(lines): 
line = lines[index] 
if line.strip()  "": 
if index + 1 < len(lines) and _is_frontmatter_key(lines[index + 1]): 
break 
index += 1 
continue 
if not line.startswith((" ", "\t")): 
break 
block_lines.append(line.strip()) 
index += 1 
return " ".join(block_lines).strip(), index


def parse_frontmatter(content: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str]: 
"""Split YAML frontmatter from markdown body.""" 
content = normalize_text(content) 
if not content.startswith("---"): 
return {}, content 
match = re.match(r"^---\r?\n(.*?)\r?\n---\r?\n?", content, re.DOTALL) 
if not match: 
return {}, content 
meta: dict[str, str] = {} 
lines = match.group(1).splitlines() 
index = 0 
while index < len(lines): 
line = lines[index] 
if not line.strip() or not _is_frontmatter_key(line): 
index += 1 
continue 
key, _, value = line.partition(":") 
key = key.strip() 
value = value.strip() 
if value in (">", "|"): 
meta[key], index = _read_block_scalar(lines, index + 1) 
continue 
if not value and key  "globs": 
globs: list[str] = [] 
index += 1 
while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip().startswith("- "): 
globs.append(lines[index].strip().removeprefix("- ").strip()) 
index += 1 
if globs: 
meta["globs"] = ",".join(globs) 
conti/--- [scripts PARTE 3/7] --- 
nue 
meta[key] = value 
index += 1 
return meta, content[match.end() :]


def yaml_quote(value: str) -> str: 
"""Quote a YAML scalar when it contains characters that need escaping.""" 
if any(char in value for char in ':"\n#[]{}'): 
escaped = value.replace("\", "\\").replace('"', '\"') 
return f'"{escaped}"' 
return value


def format_frontmatter(meta: dict[str, str]) -> str: 
if not meta: 
return "" 
lines = [ 
"---", 
*[f"{key}: {yaml_quote(value)}" for key, value in meta.items()], 
"---", 
"", 
] 
return "\n".join(lines)


def to_copilot_frontmatter(meta: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]: 
"""Convert Cursor-style frontmatter to GitHub Copilot applyTo format.""" 
copilot_meta: dict[str, str] = {} 
if description := meta.get("description"): 
copilot_meta["description"] = description

always_apply = meta.get("alwaysApply", "false").lower() == "true"
globs = meta.get("globs", "")
if always_apply:
    copilot_meta["applyTo"] = "**"
elif globs:
    copilot_meta["applyTo"] = globs
return copilot_meta
def format_claude_frontmatter(meta: dict[str, str]) -> str: 
"""Convert Cursor-style frontmatter to Claude Code paths format.""" 
lines = ["---"] 
if description := meta.get("description"): 
lines.append(f"description: {yaml_quote(description)}")

always_apply = meta.get("alwaysApply", "false").lower() == "true"
globs = meta.get("globs", "")
if not always_apply and globs:
    lines.append("paths:")
    for pattern in globs.split(","):
        pattern = pattern.strip()
        if pattern:
            lines.append(f'  - "{pattern}"')

lines.extend(["---", ""])
return "\n".join(lines)
def render_rule_content(platform: str, content: str) -> str: 
"""Render rule content with platform-specific frontmatter.""" 
if platform  "cursor": 
return content 
meta, body = parse_f/--- [scripts PARTE 4/7] --- 
rontmatter(content) 
if platform  "github": 
return f"{format_frontmatter(to_copilot_frontmatter(meta))}{body}" 
if platform  "claude": 
return f"{format_claude_frontmatter(meta)}{body}" 
return content


def dest_skill_path(platform: str, name: str, root: Path) -> Path: 
base = platform_root(platform, root) 
return base / "skills" / name / "SKILL.md"


def normalize_text(text: str) -> str: 
"""Normalize line endings and strip UTF-8 BOM for stable comparison and output.""" 
if text.startswith("\ufeff"): 
text = text[1:] 
return text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")


def read_source_text(path: Path) -> str: 
"""Read source markdown; utf-8-sig strips accidental BOM from Windows editors.""" 
return normalize_text(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


def write_if_changed(path: Path, content: str) -> bool: 
"""Write only when normalized content differs. Returns True if written.""" 
normalized = normalize_text(content) 
if path.is_file(): 
existing = normalize_text(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) 
if existing  normalized: 
return False 
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) 
path.write_text(normalized, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") 
return True


def remove_stale_files( 
directory: Path, 
patterns: tuple[str, ...], 
expected: set[Path], 
) -> int: 
"""Remove generated files no longer present in the source.""" 
removed = 0 
if not directory.is_dir(): 
return removed 
for pattern in patterns: 
for path in directory.glob(pattern): 
if path.resolve() not in expected: 
path.unlink() 
removed += 1 
return removed


def sync_ignore_files(root: Path) -> tuple[int, int]: 
"""Write per-tool ignore files so each agent reads only its synced config.""" 
written = 0 
unchanged = 0 
for filename, lines in IGNORE_FILES.items(): 
content = IGNORE_HEADER + "\n".join(line/--- [scripts PARTE 5/7] --- 
s) + "\n" 
dest = root / filename 
if write_if_changed(dest, content): 
written += 1 
print(f"Updated {filename}") 
else: 
unchanged += 1 
return written, unchanged


def remove_legacy_copilot_instructions(root: Path) -> bool: 
"""Remove deprecated duplicate; Copilot reads root AGENTS.md natively.""" 
path = root / ".github" / "copilot-instructions.md" 
if path.is_file(): 
path.unlink() 
print("Removed legacy .github/copilot-instructions.md") 
return True 
return False


def sync_agents_md(src_agents_md: Path, root: Path) -> tuple[int, int]: 
"""Sync root instruction files: AGENTS.md (persona) and CLAUDE.md import bridge.""" 
written = 0 
unchanged = 0 
if not src_agents_md.is_file(): 
return written, unchanged

agents_content = read_source_text(src_agents_md)

# Cursor, Codex, and Copilot read AGENTS.md directly
if write_if_changed(root / "AGENTS.md", agents_content):
    written += 1
    print("Updated AGENTS.md")
else:
    unchanged += 1

# Claude Code entry point references AGENTS.md
if write_if_changed(root / "CLAUDE.md", CLAUDE_ENTRY):
    written += 1
    print("Updated CLAUDE.md")
else:
    unchanged += 1

if remove_legacy_copilot_instructions(root):
    written += 1

return written, unchanged
def sync_rules(rules_src_dir: Path, root: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]: 
"""Sync rule files under rules_src_dir to all target platforms.""" 
rules_synced = 0 
written = 0 
unchanged = 0 
expected_paths: set[Path] = set()

if rules_src_dir.is_dir():
    for rule_file in rules_src_dir.glob("*.md"):
        name = rule_file.stem
        content = read_source_text(rule_file)

        for platform in PLATFORMS:
            dest = dest_rule_path(platform, name, root)
            expected_paths.add(dest.resolve())
            rendered = render_rule_content(/--- [scripts PARTE 6/7] --- platform, content) if write_if_changed(dest, rendered): written += 1 else: unchanged += 1 print(f"Synced rule: {name}") rules_synced += 1 stale_removed = 0 for platform in PLATFORMS: rules_dir = platform_root(platform, root) / ( "instructions" if platform == "github" else "rules" ) stale_removed += remove_stale_files( rules_dir, ("*.mdc", "*.md"), expected_paths ) return rules_synced, written + stale_removed, unchanged def sync_skills(skills_src_dir: Path, root: Path) -> tuple[int, int, int]: """Sync skill files under skills_src_dir to all target platforms.""" skills_synced = 0 written = 0 unchanged = 0 expected_paths: set[Path] = set() if skills_src_dir.is_dir(): for skill_dir in skills_src_dir.iterdir(): skill_md = skill_dir / "SKILL.md" if skill_md.is_file(): name = skill_dir.name content = read_source_text(skill_md) for platform in PLATFORMS: dest = dest_skill_path(platform, name, root) expected_paths.add(dest.resolve()) if write_if_changed(dest, content): written += 1 else: unchanged += 1 print(f"Synced skill: {name}") skills_synced += 1 stale_removed = 0 for platform in PLATFORMS: skills_dir = platform_root(platform, root) / "skills" stale_removed += remove_stale_files( skills_dir, ("**/SKILL.md",), expected_paths ) return skills_synced, written + stale_removed, unchanged def main() -> int: root = repo_root() src = source_root() if not src.is_dir(): print(f"Error: Source directory '.agents/' not found at {src}") return 1 print("====================
/--- [scripts PARTE 7/7] ---
") 
print("Agent Rule & Skill Sync (Source of Truth: .agents/)") 
print("\n")

agents_written, agents_unchanged = sync_agents_md(src / "AGENTS.md", root)

rules_synced, rules_written, rules_unchanged = sync_rules(src / "rules", root)

skills_synced, skills_written, skills_unchanged = sync_skills(src / "skills", root)

ignore_written, ignore_unchanged = sync_ignore_files(root)

files_written = agents_written + rules_written + skills_written + ignore_written
files_unchanged = (
    agents_unchanged + rules_unchanged + skills_unchanged + ignore_unchanged
)

print("\n==================================================")
print(
    f"Sync complete! {rules_synced} rule(s), {skills_synced} skill(s); "
    f"{files_written} file(s) updated, {files_unchanged} unchanged."
)
for label in PLATFORM_LABELS.values():
    print(f"  - {label}")
print("==================================================")
return 0
